req.title: PUT is idempotent
req.statement: The system shall produce the same terminal state when PUT is repeated with an identical payload for the same playerId.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the PUT operation should be idempotent, meaning that repeated requests with the same payload should result in the same state and response. This is crucial for ensuring consistency in RESTful APIs. The tests are designed to verify this behavior by checking the response status and ensuring no unintended changes occur when the same request is repeated.

tests.name: test_put_idempotency_positive
actions: Send PUT request to update player with squad number 10
Repeat the PUT request with the same payload
expected: Both requests return HTTP 204 No Content
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "Lionel",
    "middleName": "Andrés",
    "lastName": "Messi",
    "dateOfBirth": "1987-06-24T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 10,
    "position": "Right Winger",
    "abbrPosition": "RW",
    "team": "Paris Saint-Germain",
    "league": "Ligue 1",
    "starting11": True
}

response1 = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=player_data)
assert response1.status_code == 204

response2 = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=player_data)
assert response2.status_code == 204

actions: Send PUT request with mismatched squad number in path and body
tests.executable:

from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "Lionel",
    "middleName": "Andrés",
    "lastName": "Messi",
    "dateOfBirth": "1987-06-24T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 11,
    "position": "Right Winger",
    "abbrPosition": "RW",
    "team": "Paris Saint-Germain",
    "league": "Ligue 1",
    "starting11": True
}

response = client.put("/players/squadnumber/10", json=player_data)
assert response.status_code == 400

tests.name: test_put_idempotency_boundary
actions: Send PUT request to update player with squad number 1
Repeat the PUT request with the same payload
expected: Both requests return HTTP 204 No Content
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

player_data = {
    "firstName": "Franco",
    "middleName": "Daniel",
    "lastName": "Armani",
    "dateOfBirth": "1986-10-16T00:00:00.000Z",
    "squadNumber": 1,
    "position": "Goalkeeper",
    "abbrPosition": "GK",
    "team": "River Plate",
    "league": "Copa de la Liga",
    "starting11": False
}

response1 = client.put("/players/squadnumber/1", json=player_data)
assert response1.status_code == 204

response2 = client.put("/players/squadnumber/1", json=player_data)
assert response2.status_code == 204
